en-US.description: Make your own custom map of the world with colors. You can create map charts to compare values of geographical regions. You can export and import the country data as CSV file and create the geochart in HTML format.
en-US.longDescription:
Make your own custom map of the world with colors. You can create map charts to compare values of geographical regions. You can export and import the country data as CSV file and create the geochart in HTML format. This software utilizes Google GeoChart in order to export Region GeoCharts.

Create maps in just a few simple steps, with this straightforward app that supports CSV data import and yields HTML layouts.

Using various colors on maps can make a huge difference in how the information that needs to be conveyed is perceived by the end-user. Resorting to various shades of a different color for depicting the amplitude of a certain value can portray statistical data in a very efficient manner. Vovsoft Map Chart Creator will allow you to easily create such maps, using a simple country listing view, with manually adjustable values and HTML output renders for the resulting charts.

Users will be presented with a list view of all the countries, coupled with a field that holds the values for each. Editing that value is quite simple and once all the preferred values have been adjusted, generating the corresponding map graph is instantaneous.

Save your data to CSV format or load existing lists if you need to work with external data. The list of defined values can be saved to disk into CSV format, which makes things easier when wanting to work with pre-defined values. Editing the list in Excel for further processing means that loading values can be done much faster.

This software is a minimalist map chart maker that allows you to use various values for portraying them with different color nuances. The resulting map will be rendered into HTML format and the final layout also includes an amplitude legend, for the depicted values.

This application is a good tool for those who wish to create maps that can portray statistical values across the world’s countries. With a simple input method and supporting CSV format as import, it renders basic ramp maps into HTML format.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Map Chart Creator
